title: Cheese wedge with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD23F'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#F5B800'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E09E00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseFront' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFC93C'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#EDA800'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- wedge silhouette: top face -->
  <polygon points='12,68 50,30 88,68' fill='url(#cheeseTop)'/>

  <!-- underside / side band -->
  <polygon points='12,68 88,68 88,78 12,78' fill='url(#cheeseSide)'/>

  <!-- front face -->
  <polygon points='12,68 88,68 88,78 12,78' fill='url(#cheeseFront)' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- front face top highlight -->
  <polygon points='12,68 50,30 88,68' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- cheese holes on top -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='58' rx='5' ry='3.4' fill='#E09E00'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='58' rx='5' ry='3.4' fill='none' stroke='#FFEB99' stroke-width='1.3'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='62' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='#E09E00'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='62' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='none' stroke='#FFEB99' stroke-width='1.3'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='47' rx='3.4' ry='2.4' fill='#E09E00'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='47' rx='3.4' ry='2.4' fill='none' stroke='#FFEB99' stroke-width='1.3'/>

  <!-- face on top -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#5A3A00'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#5A3A00'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='49' r='1' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='49' r='1' fill='#FFF3B0'/>

  <!-- smiling mouth curve -->
  <path d='M40 56 Q50 64 60 56' fill='none' stroke='#5A3A00' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='55' rx='3.2' ry='2.2' fill='#FF9A6B' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='55' rx='3.2' ry='2.2' fill='#FF9A6B' opacity='0.75'/>
</svg>
